summary: Checkpoint for owner request to restore the ICARUS desktop dashboard and make the complete dashboard viewable on a phone using Git Bash commands. Local repository inspection confirms responsive dashboard CSS exists, but the HTTP server binds only to 127.0.0.1 and its Host guard accepts only localhost/loopback. No mobile gateway package was found in the inspected workspace. A generic Tailscale Serve reverse proxy was previously suggested but has not been tested against this Host guard, so no phone URL or remote-access recipe is verified yet. Desktop start guidance was identified in the plant README/CLI; user-local repository path is not discoverable from this workspace, so the eventual Git Bash-only instructions must locate the checkout rather than assume a drive/path.
dependencies: verification:private mobile access gateway compatible with loopback-only Host guard
verification:Git Bash-only checkout discovery and dashboard start instructions
evidence: Inspected Icarus checkout branch codex/a200-runtime-bridge-plan-20261016 at 0e772ec4541cc3b26e34da13de3a7832a614e3c0; worktree was clean.
icarus_engine/server.py binds ThreadingHTTPServer to 127.0.0.1 and _host_ok allows loopback/local Host values only.
No mobile gateway package was found in inspected workspace paths.
Plant launcher provides local dashboard startup on 127.0.0.1:8791; this is local desktop availability only.
Tailscale Serve compatibility with server Host validation has not been verified. Do not treat it as a working phone link or disable the Host guard/use public exposure as a workaround.
